etsy.title: Certified Clapper Hockey Poster, Funny Slapshot Print, Man Cave Wall Art, Player Gift
etsy.description:
A certified clapper hockey poster for anyone who rips slapshots with no apologies, featuring crossed sticks and bold typography.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 11×17 in
• Printed on premium matte paper at 300 DPI

HOW TO USE
Frame and hang in a man cave, garage, game room, or hockey bar.

This listing is a physical poster print. Generic design: no league, team, or club marks. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: Clapper hockey products on Etsy are mostly moisture-wicking tees and stickers; no poster prints found.
Hockey man cave products are mostly custom wood signs, metal signs, and LED neon lights.
Beer league hockey listings include vintage pond hockey prints and parody art.
Amazon hockey man cave items are mostly tin signs at 8x12 inches around $14.99.
Slapshot-themed posters on Amazon are mostly action photography or motivational quotes.

research.notes: Clapper is well-known hockey slang for slapshot. No competing poster prints use this term on Etsy, making it an open niche.
